key_insight: PEPRino is a hyperparameter- and gradient-free optimal control method that uses infinite-order response-function information, resummed from first- and second-order terms, to generate high-fidelity quantum control pulses.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical route to more reliable pulse design for multi-qubit quantum algorithms, where control landscapes are high-dimensional and convergence sensitivity is a major bottleneck.
method: Uses response theory to map the control landscape beyond low-order approximations
Resums infinite nonlinear response contributions from first- and second-order response functions
Applies the method to 2-qubit and 3-qubit Quantum Fourier Transform (QFT) pulse synthesis
evidence_signal: In the 2-qubit QFT benchmark against CRAB with Nelder-Mead, PEPRino showed faster convergence in both iteration count and computational time.
watch_item: The abstract only reports benchmarking on small qubit systems, so scalability and cost for larger devices remain to be validated.
paper_title: Pulse engineering via projection of response functions at infinite nonlinear order
